summary: Checkout service p99 latency spike and 5xx errors after deploy
expected_root_cause: The v2.14.0 deploy introduced a background task that opens a DB session without releasing it, leaking connections and exhausting the checkout-service Postgres connection pool, which caused request timeouts and 5xx errors.
relevant_knowledge_sections: runbook:checkout-service › Known failure mode: DB connection pool exhaustion
expected_evidence_signals: QueuePool limit ... overflow ... reached error logs
deploy v2.14.0 timestamp precedes error onset
db.acquire_connection trace spans dominate duration, not payment-gateway
